title: Syrian Lamb Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Syrian-inspired lamb stir fry dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then add the sliced onions and bell peppers. Cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry sauce and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with pita bread.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
